bias.zh: 偏空 · 逼近 200 日均线

read.en: Applied Materials fell 3.8% on Oct 14 to $446.63 on heavy volume and is down 14% in five sessions. It is below its 5-day ($485.0), 10-day ($508.8), 30-day ($475.7) and 100-day ($517.2) averages and 2% above the rising 200-day ($437.5). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 13 but is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($537.9), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月14日放量下跌 3.8%，收于 $446.63，五个交易日下跌 14%。股价位于 5 日（$485.0）、10 日（$508.8）、30 日（$475.7）和 100 日均线（$517.2）下方，比上行的 200 日均线（$437.5）高 2%。MACD 于 10月13日下穿信号线，但仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$537.9），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The Oct 13 low ($453) gave way, with a day's low of $445.54; the $453–459 band is now first resistance, then $476 (30-day average) and $485 (5-day). Support is $436–437 (Jul 29 pivot and 200-day average), then $426 (Sep 3 low) and $411.5 (Sep 16 low). A close below $436 would open $426.
